comment: Known map/railways.txt defects, measured by tools/validators/validate_adiscord_map_railways.py on 2026-08-19. Each adjacency break is a place where two consecutive provinces on a railway do not share a border, so supply stops flowing along the line. missing_provinces is the shortest all-land insertion that would repair it. Repairing one changes which provinces a supply line runs through, which is a gameplay decision, and map/railways.txt is generated output owned by tools/builders/build_adiscord_vorkerland_theatre.py, so the repair belongs in that builder rather than here. These entries exist so the tail stays visible and so any NEW break fails validation.
max_recorded_worst_step_comment: The largest elevation change in height units between two consecutive provinces on any railway, using each province's median height. Line 129 sets it while crossing five declared-mountain provinces. Raising this number means a railway started climbing harder; the fix is to carve a saddle along the existing line in map/heightmap.bmp, not to reroute it.
